newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB to appoint Togo as new president.
newsitem.headline: NCB to appoint Togo as new president.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd will appoint Vice President Shigeoki Togo as its new president at a board meeting to be held on Wednesday morning, industry sources said.
Current NCB president and chairman Hiroshi Kubota will remain as chairman, said the sources, who did not want to be identified.
The said NCB would hold a news conference on the personnel change in the afternoon.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that Kubota had decided to step down as president as he had completed his responsibilities in NCB's restructuring.
One of the key parts of the bank's restructuring plan -- a boosting of its capital, was completed on Tuesday. the paper said.
